greeting: Let me look at you, {player}. Sit, breathe, tell me where it hurts.
Plenty of bandages, no judgement. What happened?
Quick check, quick fix. Hold your arm out.
farewell: Keep your head down and your hearts up.
Try not to need me again. I will be here if you do.
bark: The cure for most things is sleep and bandages.
I have seen worse. I have also seen the same, twice.
The coffee here is medicinal. Do not ask what it treats.
Nothing is broken that cannot be taped.
healed: There. Good as new, give or take a scar.
All patched up, {player}. Try to keep it that way.
Healed. That will be {price} eddies and a promise to be careful.
Sit back, you are done. Slowly now.
Your hearts are full again. Treat them kindly.
no_funds: I cannot treat you for free, {player}. It costs {price}.
That is {price} eddies. Bring them and I will be quick.
Come back with the fee. I will be here.
